tests.name: Hemoglobin (Hb)
tests.high_indication: Polycythemia vera, chronic hypoxia (COPD, high altitude), dehydration, smoking
tests.low_indication: Anemia (iron, B12, folate deficiency), acute or chronic blood loss, hemolysis, chronic kidney disease

tests.name: Hematocrit (Hct)
tests.high_indication: Polycythemia vera, dehydration, chronic hypoxia
tests.low_indication: Anemia, hemorrhage, hemodilution (fluid overload, pregnancy)

tests.name: Red Blood Cell (RBC) Count
tests.high_indication: Erythrocytosis (polycythemia vera, chronic hypoxia, erythropoietin-secreting tumors)
tests.low_indication: Anemia, acute blood loss, hemolysis, marrow failure

tests.name: Total Leukocyte Count (WBC)
tests.high_indication: Bacterial infections, inflammation, leukemia, corticosteroids, stress response, burns
tests.low_indication: Viral infections, sepsis, aplastic anemia, chemotherapy or radiation, hypersplenism, B12/folate deficiency

tests.name: Platelet Count
tests.high_indication: Reactive thrombocytosis (iron deficiency, infection, inflammation), essential thrombocythemia, post-splenectomy
tests.low_indication: ITP, TTP, DIC, hypersplenism, marrow infiltration or failure, heparin-induced thrombocytopenia (HIT)

tests.name: Mean Corpuscular Volume (MCV)
tests.high_indication: Macrocytic anemia (B12/folate deficiency), liver disease, hypothyroidism, MDS
tests.low_indication: Iron deficiency anemia, thalassemia, anemia of chronic disease, sideroblastic anemia

tests.name: Mean Corpuscular Hemoglobin (MCH)
tests.high_indication: Macrocytic anemia (B12/folate deficiency)
tests.low_indication: Iron deficiency anemia, thalassemia, microcytic anemia

tests.name: Mean Corpuscular Hemoglobin Concentration (MCHC)
tests.high_indication: Hereditary spherocytosis, severe dehydration (artifact)
tests.low_indication: Iron deficiency anemia, thalassemia, anemia of chronic disease

tests.name: Red Cell Distribution Width (RDW)
tests.high_indication: Anisocytosis: mixed deficiency anemia, early iron deficiency, post-transfusion, MDS
tests.low_indication: Not clinically significant

tests.name: Neutrophils (Absolute Count)
tests.high_indication: Bacterial infections, tissue necrosis, inflammation, corticosteroids, myeloproliferative disorders
tests.low_indication: Viral infections, drug-induced agranulocytosis (chemotherapy, antithyroid drugs), aplastic anemia, severe sepsis

tests.name: Lymphocytes (Absolute Count)
tests.high_indication: Viral infections (EBV, CMV, viral hepatitis), chronic lymphocytic leukemia, lymphoma, pertussis
tests.low_indication: HIV, corticosteroids, chemotherapy or radiation, malnutrition, severe acute stress

tests.name: Monocytes (Absolute Count)
tests.high_indication: Chronic infections (tuberculosis, subacute bacterial endocarditis), CMML, collagen vascular disease
tests.low_indication: Usually not clinically significant; aplastic states, corticosteroids

tests.name: Eosinophils (Absolute Count)
tests.high_indication: Allergic diseases (asthma, atopic dermatitis), parasitic infections, drug reactions, eosinophilic syndromes, adrenal insufficiency
tests.low_indication: Corticosteroid use, Cushing syndrome, acute bacterial infection (stress response)

tests.name: Basophils (Absolute Count)
tests.high_indication: Myeloproliferative disorders (CML, polycythemia vera), hypersensitivity reactions, hypothyroidism
tests.low_indication: Hyperthyroidism, acute stress, corticosteroids (generally not significant)

tests.name: Reticulocyte Count
tests.high_indication: Hemolytic anemia, acute blood loss, response to iron, B12 or folate therapy
tests.low_indication: Aplastic anemia, marrow infiltration, untreated iron/B12/folate deficiency, renal failure (low erythropoietin)

tests.name: Mean Platelet Volume (MPV)
tests.high_indication: ITP (release of young platelets), myeloproliferative disorders, pre-eclampsia
tests.low_indication: Aplastic anemia, chemotherapy, Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome

tests.name: Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR)
tests.high_indication: Infection, chronic inflammation (rheumatoid arthritis, temporal arteritis, PMR), malignancy, pregnancy, anemia
tests.low_indication: Polycythemia vera, sickle cell disease, congestive heart failure, hypofibrinogenemia

tests.name: C-Reactive Protein (CRP)
tests.high_indication: Acute bacterial infection, inflammation, autoimmune flares, tissue necrosis, myocardial infarction
tests.low_indication: Not clinically significant (helps rule out active inflammation/infection)

tests.name: Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN)
tests.high_indication: Renal failure (prerenal, intrinsic, postrenal), dehydration, GI bleeding, high protein intake, catabolic state
tests.low_indication: Advanced liver disease, malnutrition, low protein intake, overhydration (SIADH)

tests.name: Serum Creatinine
tests.high_indication: Acute kidney injury, chronic kidney disease, dehydration, rhabdomyolysis, urinary tract obstruction
tests.low_indication: Decreased muscle mass, pregnancy, severe liver disease

tests.name: BUN/Creatinine Ratio
tests.high_indication: Prerenal azotemia (dehydration, heart failure), GI bleeding, hypercatabolic states
tests.low_indication: Intrinsic renal disease, acute tubular necrosis, low protein intake, severe liver disease, rhabdomyolysis

tests.name: Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (eGFR)
tests.high_indication: Hyperfiltration (early diabetic nephropathy, pregnancy, high-protein diet)
tests.low_indication: Chronic kidney disease (60 - 89 mild, 30 - 59 moderate, 15 - 29 severe, < 15 kidney failure), acute kidney injury

tests.name: Serum Uric Acid
tests.high_indication: Gout, renal failure, tumor lysis syndrome, diuretics, metabolic syndrome, psoriasis, cytotoxic therapy
tests.low_indication: SIADH, allopurinol/febuxostat therapy, Fanconi syndrome, severe liver disease

tests.name: Creatinine Clearance (24-hour urine)
tests.high_indication: Early diabetic nephropathy (hyperfiltration), pregnancy
tests.low_indication: Declining GFR, chronic kidney disease, acute kidney injury

tests.name: Alanine Aminotransferase (ALT / SGPT)
tests.high_indication: Hepatocellular injury (viral hepatitis, drug-induced, NAFLD, ischemic hepatitis, alcohol below AST)
tests.low_indication: Not clinically significant (rarely vitamin B6 deficiency)

tests.name: Aspartate Aminotransferase (AST / SGOT)
tests.high_indication: Hepatocellular injury, myocardial infarction, skeletal muscle injury, rhabdomyolysis, hemolysis
tests.low_indication: Not clinically significant

tests.name: AST/ALT Ratio (De Ritis Ratio)
tests.high_indication: Alcoholic liver disease, cirrhosis (ratio > 2.0), NASH with advanced fibrosis
tests.low_indication: Viral hepatitis, early NAFLD, toxic hepatitis

tests.name: Alkaline Phosphatase (ALP)
tests.high_indication: Cholestasis/biliary obstruction, infiltrative liver disease (metastases, granulomas), Paget disease, bone metastases, hyperparathyroidism, pregnancy
tests.low_indication: Hypophosphatasia, zinc deficiency, hypothyroidism, malnutrition

tests.name: Gamma-Glutamyl Transferase (GGT)
tests.high_indication: Alcohol use/abuse, cholestasis/biliary disease, enzyme inducers (phenytoin, barbiturates), pancreatic disease
tests.low_indication: Not clinically significant

tests.name: Total Bilirubin
tests.high_indication: Hemolysis, Gilbert syndrome, hepatocellular disease (hepatitis, cirrhosis), biliary obstruction (choledocholithiasis, pancreatic head cancer)
tests.low_indication: Not clinically significant

tests.name: Direct (Conjugated) Bilirubin
tests.high_indication: Cholestasis, biliary obstruction, Dubin-Johnson and Rotor syndromes, sepsis
tests.low_indication: Not clinically significant

tests.name: Indirect (Unconjugated) Bilirubin
tests.high_indication: Hemolysis, Gilbert syndrome, Crigler-Najjar syndrome, ineffective erythropoiesis (megaloblastic anemia)
tests.low_indication: Not clinically significant

tests.name: Total Protein
tests.high_indication: Dehydration, multiple myeloma, Waldenström macroglobulinemia, chronic inflammation/infection (hypergammaglobulinemia)
tests.low_indication: Malnutrition, liver failure, nephrotic syndrome, protein-losing enteropathy, burns, overhydration

tests.name: Serum Albumin
tests.high_indication: Dehydration, anabolic steroid use
tests.low_indication: Cirrhosis/chronic liver disease, nephrotic syndrome, malnutrition, protein-losing enteropathy, burns, chronic inflammation

tests.name: Serum Globulin
tests.high_indication: Chronic infections (tuberculosis, hepatitis), autoimmune disease, multiple myeloma, lymphoma, sarcoidosis
tests.low_indication: Immunodeficiency states, nephrotic syndrome, malnutrition, immunosuppressive therapy

tests.name: Albumin/Globulin (A/G) Ratio
tests.high_indication: Hypogammaglobulinemia (immunodeficiency)
tests.low_indication: Hypergammaglobulinemia (chronic infection, myeloma, autoimmune disease), hypoalbuminemia (cirrhosis, nephrotic syndrome)

tests.name: Lactate Dehydrogenase (LDH)
tests.high_indication: Hemolysis, megaloblastic anemia, myocardial infarction, malignancy/lymphoma, hepatocellular injury, pulmonary embolism, rhabdomyolysis
tests.low_indication: Not clinically significant

tests.name: pH
tests.high_indication: Alkalosis (respiratory: hyperventilation, anxiety, pain, sepsis; metabolic: vomiting, diuretics, hyperaldosteronism)
tests.low_indication: Acidosis (respiratory: hypoventilation, COPD, CNS depression; metabolic: DKA, lactic acidosis, renal failure, diarrhea)

tests.name: Partial Pressure of CO2 (PaCO2)
tests.high_indication: Respiratory acidosis (COPD, hypoventilation, CNS depression, neuromuscular disease), compensation for metabolic alkalosis
tests.low_indication: Respiratory alkalosis (anxiety, pain, sepsis, pulmonary embolism, salicylate toxicity), compensation for metabolic acidosis

tests.name: Partial Pressure of O2 (PaO2)
tests.high_indication: Hyperoxia (excessive supplemental oxygen)
tests.low_indication: Hypoxemia: V/Q mismatch, shunt, hypoventilation, diffusion impairment (pneumonia, ARDS, pulmonary embolism, pulmonary edema)

tests.name: Bicarbonate (HCO3-)
tests.high_indication: Metabolic alkalosis (vomiting, NG suction, diuretics), compensation for chronic respiratory acidosis (COPD)
tests.low_indication: Metabolic acidosis (DKA, lactic acidosis, renal failure, diarrhea), compensation for chronic respiratory alkalosis

tests.name: Oxygen Saturation (SaO2)
tests.high_indication: Supplemental oxygen administration (not pathological)
tests.low_indication: Hypoxemia (pneumonia, ARDS, pulmonary embolism, COPD exacerbation, shunt, high altitude)

tests.name: Base Excess/Deficit
tests.high_indication: Metabolic alkalosis, compensation for chronic respiratory acidosis
tests.low_indication: Metabolic acidosis (shock, sepsis, DKA, tissue hypoxia, renal failure)

tests.name: Arterial Lactate
tests.high_indication: Type A: tissue hypoxia (septic, cardiogenic or hemorrhagic shock, severe hypoxemia); Type B: metformin, alcohol, liver failure, seizures, malignancy
tests.low_indication: Not clinically significant

tests.name: Alveolar-Arterial (A-a) Gradient
tests.high_indication: V/Q mismatch, shunt, diffusion impairment (pulmonary embolism, ARDS, pneumonia, pulmonary edema, fibrosis)
tests.low_indication: Not clinically significant (with hypoxemia suggests hypoventilation or low inspired FiO2)

tests.name: Prothrombin Time (PT)
tests.high_indication: Warfarin use, vitamin K deficiency, liver disease, DIC, congenital factor VII/II/V/X deficiency, biliary obstruction, malabsorption
tests.low_indication: Not clinically significant

tests.name: International Normalized Ratio (INR)
tests.high_indication: Warfarin therapy (target 2.0 - 3.0 for most indications), liver failure, DIC, vitamin K deficiency, warfarin overdose
tests.low_indication: Not clinically significant

tests.name: Activated Partial Thromboplastin Time (aPTT)
tests.high_indication: Heparin therapy, hemophilia A/B, von Willebrand disease, lupus anticoagulant, DIC, congenital factor VIII/IX/XI/XII deficiency
tests.low_indication: Acute-phase reaction, early or compensated DIC (hypercoagulable state)

tests.name: Fibrinogen
tests.high_indication: Acute-phase reactant: infection, inflammation, pregnancy, tissue injury, malignancy
tests.low_indication: DIC, severe liver failure, congenital hypofibrinogenemia/afibrinogenemia, thrombolytic therapy, placental abruption, HELLP syndrome

tests.name: D-Dimer
tests.high_indication: Deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, DIC, recent surgery/trauma, pregnancy, malignancy, inflammation (high sensitivity, low specificity)
tests.low_indication: Not clinically significant (rules out VTE when clinical probability is low)

tests.name: Fibrin/Fibrinogen Degradation Products (FDP)
tests.high_indication: DIC, thrombolytic therapy, primary fibrinolysis, recent surgery or trauma
tests.low_indication: Not clinically significant

tests.name: Thrombin Time (TT)
tests.high_indication: Heparin/direct thrombin inhibitor therapy, DIC, dysfibrinogenemia, hypofibrinogenemia
tests.low_indication: Not clinically significant

tests.name: Sodium (Na+)
tests.high_indication: Dehydration/hypovolemia, diabetes insipidus, osmotic diuresis, hyperaldosteronism, Cushing syndrome
tests.low_indication: SIADH, diuretics, heart failure, cirrhosis, adrenal insufficiency, psychogenic polydipsia, pseudohyponatremia

tests.name: Potassium (K+)
tests.high_indication: Renal failure, acidosis, K+-sparing diuretics (spironolactone), Addison disease, tissue breakdown (tumor lysis, rhabdomyolysis), pseudohyperkalemia (hemolyzed sample)
tests.low_indication: Vomiting/diarrhea, loop and thiazide diuretics, insulin/glucose shift, alkalosis, hyperaldosteronism, refeeding syndrome

tests.name: Chloride (Cl-)
tests.high_indication: Dehydration, renal tubular acidosis, normal saline overuse, hyperparathyroidism, compensation for respiratory alkalosis
tests.low_indication: Vomiting/NG suction, diuretics, SIADH, metabolic alkalosis, compensation for chronic respiratory acidosis

tests.name: Bicarbonate (Total CO2 Content)
tests.high_indication: Metabolic alkalosis (vomiting, diuretics, hyperaldosteronism), compensation for chronic respiratory acidosis (COPD)
tests.low_indication: Metabolic acidosis (DKA, lactic acidosis, renal failure, diarrhea), compensation for respiratory alkalosis

tests.name: Anion Gap
tests.high_indication: High anion gap metabolic acidosis - MUDPILES: methanol, uremia, DKA, propylene glycol, isoniazid/iron, lactic acidosis, ethylene glycol, salicylates
tests.low_indication: Hypoalbuminemia, multiple myeloma, paraproteinemia, bromide or lithium intoxication

tests.name: Calcium (Total)
tests.high_indication: Primary/tertiary hyperparathyroidism, malignancy (PTHrP, bone metastases, myeloma), vitamin D toxicity, sarcoidosis, thiazide diuretics
tests.low_indication: Hypoparathyroidism/post-thyroidectomy, vitamin D deficiency, chronic kidney disease, pancreatitis, magnesium deficiency, massive transfusion (citrate)

tests.name: Calcium (Ionized)
tests.high_indication: Hyperparathyroidism, malignancy, acidosis (increases ionized fraction)
tests.low_indication: Alkalosis/hyperventilation (decreases ionized fraction), massive transfusion (citrate), hypoparathyroidism, chronic kidney disease

tests.name: Magnesium (Mg2+)
tests.high_indication: Renal failure, magnesium-containing antacids/laxatives, adrenal insufficiency, lithium therapy
tests.low_indication: Alcoholism, loop/thiazide diuretics, proton pump inhibitors, diarrhea/malabsorption, DKA treatment, refeeding syndrome

tests.name: Phosphorus (Phosphate)
tests.high_indication: Chronic kidney disease, tumor lysis syndrome, hypoparathyroidism, vitamin D toxicity, rhabdomyolysis
tests.low_indication: Refeeding syndrome, hyperparathyroidism, vitamin D deficiency, respiratory alkalosis, malabsorption, alcoholism

tests.name: Glucose (Fasting)
tests.high_indication: Diabetes mellitus, stress hyperglycemia, corticosteroids, pancreatitis, Cushing syndrome, acromegaly
tests.low_indication: Insulin/sulfonylurea excess, alcohol ingestion, insulinoma, adrenal insufficiency, liver failure, late sepsis

tests.name: Serum Osmolality
tests.high_indication: Hypernatremia, hyperglycemia, mannitol, diabetes insipidus, toxic alcohol ingestion (elevated osmolar gap)
tests.low_indication: Hypotonic hyponatremia, SIADH, primary polydipsia, overhydration
